hooks.name: Citation check
hooks.description: After a backend Python file is saved, run the evidence property tests: every brief and backlog item must cite at least one 311 ticket ID.

action.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && DRAINFAST_FALLBACK=1 "$( [ -x .venv/bin/python ] && echo .venv/bin/python || echo python )" -m pytest tests/backend -q -k evidence -p no:warnings
